info.name: 1Fort API Documentation Email AI Agent - Attachments API

params.name: id
params.description: A UUID string identifying this Email Attachment.

items.docs:
Update attachment metadata after classification/extraction.

**Merge semantics**: keys present in the request body overwrite the
corresponding keys on the row; keys absent from the body are preserved.
The agent only needs to send the fields it wants to change.

Use this endpoint to record:
- Document type classification
- Processing status
- Extraction results (insureds found, coverage types)

**Authentication**: Requires API Key + Session Token

**Scoping**: Attachment must belong to an email
